title: A Dehornoy-Type Ordering on Bridge Positions of Links
summary: By a theorem of Hovland, bridge isotopy classes of $n$-bridge positions of links in $S^3$ correspond bijectively to Hilden double cosets $P_{2n}=H_{2n}\backslash B_{2n}/H_{2n}$. We use this correspondence to introduce Dehornoy-type orderings on bridge positions. After fixing a proper complexity function on $B_{2n}$, we assign to each double coset its Dehornoy-minimal braid among the elements of minimal complexity.
